_comment: Lasting injuries left by badly healed wounds and some diseases. effects: skills = changes to skill bonuses; attack = to attack rolls; travel = multiplier on journey time; speed = feet; social = how people see you (M5). parts: which wounds can leave it.

scar.name: a scar
scar.text: A pale, puckered line where the wound closed. It aches in the cold.

facial_scar.name: a scarred face
facial_scar.text: The face will never be quite what it was. Some look away; some look twice.

lost_eye.name: a lost eye
lost_eye.text: One eye is gone. Distances are hard to judge and the blind side is always there.

lost_fingers.name: lost fingers
lost_fingers.text: Two fingers gone from one hand. Fine work is clumsy now.

weak_arm.name: a weak arm
weak_arm.text: The bone set crooked. The arm tires fast and never grips quite true.

limp.name: a limp
limp.text: The leg healed short or stiff. Every road is a little longer now.

bad_lungs.name: bad lungs
bad_lungs.text: Since the fever, a cough that never quite goes, and no wind for running.
